svg.title: 06 · Commands follow the event's features
svg.text: Use case: the event admin sees which commands Demo Community has, per feature flag; turning a feature off removes its commands from the server (#121, bot.md Slash commands per guild).

g.text: Registered in Demo Community at 20:02 · 9 commands, 2 menus
Names and help in English and Finnish, from the event's languages. Crew commands show to everyone; the rights are checked when used.
/ticker set · stop · status · schedule add · list · remove
Menus: Send to the screen · Remove from the screen
No command: counts for the screens, live names for the hub

svg.text: A · Desktop 1280 px: one row per feature; the switch is the event's feature flag

g.text: No command; it feeds the screens
